# teams_tenant_network_region (Resource)

Manages the TenantNetworkRegion policy via New-CsTenantNetworkRegion / Get-CsTenantNetworkRegion / Set-CsTenantNetworkRegion / Remove-CsTenantNetworkRegion.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `bypass_id` (String) Maps to the -BypassID parameter.
- `central_site` (String) Maps to the -CentralSite parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `network_region_id` (String) Maps to the -NetworkRegionID parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
